name: com.securealy/mcp
title: Securealy
description: Grade a URL as an attacker and a customer would see it; scan a repo; check Supabase, Stripe, Vercel.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your Supabase project URL, read by check_rls. Sent only to that project.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Service role key for check_rls. Sent only to your Supabase project, never printed.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_MGMT_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Supabase management token for check_rls and the auth config check. Sent only to the Supabase management API.

environmentVariables.name: SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Supabase project ref, used with SUPABASE_MGMT_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Stripe secret key for check_stripe. Sent only to api.stripe.com, never printed.

environmentVariables.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Project-scoped Vercel token for check_vercel_env. Sent only to api.vercel.com, never printed.

environmentVariables.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Vercel project id for check_vercel_env.

environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_NO_HISTORY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to stop the server appending each run (grade, score, counts, failing check ids; never evidence) to .securealy/history.json in its working directory.

environmentVariables.name: SECUREALY_TELEMETRY
environmentVariables.description: Optional, off by default. Set to 1 to send an anonymous aggregate of each run (command, grade, counts, stack kind, failing check ids; no URL, host or evidence) to securealy.com.
